html:
Malangatana Ngwenya was a Mozambican painter and poet, one of the best known African artists of the 20th century.

Born in a village in the south, he worked as a ball boy and waiter at a club in Lourenço Marques, where an architect and others encouraged him. His crowded paintings of faces, eyes, teeth and bodies, in strong colours, spoke of violence, fear and myth under colonial rule.

The Portuguese secret police jailed him in the 1960s for links with FRELIMO. After independence he painted murals in Maputo and worked for peace and culture. His work is in museums around the world, and he is a central figure of the modern art of Mozambique.
sum: Malangatana Ngwenya was a Mozambican painter and poet, one of the best known African artists of the 20th century.
